name: User info
description: Returns registration information for the caller with its own whole authority, or an operator view with admin/user/read on <venueDID>/users.

did.description: User DID; defaults to the authenticated caller

storage.description: What the user's data takes up as stored, in bytes

workspace.description: The user's workspace (w) and their agents' workspaces (n)

drives.description: The user's DLFS drives, deleted drives' markers included; absent without the dlfs adapter

meta.description: The venue's activity times for the user (created, updated), shown to venue operators only
